analysis.about: A daughter's ease ends with her father's call.
analysis.dramatic_question: Will she keep their moment or go home to obey?

treatment.name: Her Hands Decide
treatment.concept: we make the viewer feel the private cost by staying with her face and hands
treatment.pov: Anudi’s throughout; it never leaves her
treatment.sound_concept: the world narrows to her breath and the small speaker; at the turn everything outside drops away

closer to the phone between them; light on her fingers
stay on her face as the voice arrives; background soft
tighten to eyes and mouth; time seems to pause
her thumb ends the call and turns the phone face-down; a last close farewell passes small

plant.payoff_when: turned face-down again after the call

remain composed; no reframing as the call begins, distance kept

let the frame breathe back so the whole bench and shore return to view

n1 [audience, high, add -> other:Dasun] card 6: At the moment the father's line lands (card 6) the audience needs a clear visual of the other person’s ignorance: add a tight reaction shot of Dasun (watching, uncomprehending) simultaneous with or immediately after the line so the viewer can see who does and doesn't know without hearing the words.

n2 [opportunity, high, add -> stake:dasun:after] card 6: You need a clear listener shot of Dasun the instant L4 is spoken — a cut to his face (MS/MCU) showing that he remains unaware of the content. This preserves the dramatic irony and orients the audience to who knows what at the break.

n3 [fidelity, high, add -> other:2:dasun] card 12: Card 12 lacks the required moment showing Dasun's held stillness as she watches her leave; add a short MS of him on the bench, unmoving and not reaching, to explicitly show 'no call to stop her' (coverage referenced by the report).

n4 [audience, medium, change] card 8: Cards 6–9 hold long, similar close-ups on Anudi; insert a quick cut to her hands/phone during the hold (a subtle thumbnail tremor or gripping the bench) to break visual monotony and give a concrete physical baseline for the emotional turn.

n5 [audience, medium, add -> stake:Dasun:after] card 9: When she complies on the call (card 9), we never see Dasun's face as the decision/break is confirmed; add a brief shot of him immediately after her line so the scene tells both sides of the break (speaker and listener) before she leaves.

n6 [editor, medium, remove] card 3: Card 3 (Dasun’s tease) repeats the same size/angle and warm coverage already established in Card 1 and Card 2 and doesn't add a distinct motive — it reads like coverage padding. Either replace it with a distinct reaction (a smaller, asymmetric detail of his face/hands) or remove it so the cut moves more economically from the shared MS/MCU into the phone buzz.

n7 [editor, medium, change] card 7: Card 7 (He doesn’t hear it) sits after a long CU on Anudi and risks breaking eye-trace: the spectator is locked on her down-eyeline, so the MS of Dasun needs a clearer visual reason to cut — give him an explicit, readable posture (looking slightly away or turning toward the lake) or shorten this to a quick insert that confirms his obliviousness without diluting the intimate POV on Anudi.

n8 [opportunity, medium, change] card 8: The slow push-in and another long CU stack on top of the previous close; remove the push-in and hold the CU instead so the change in her eyes reads without competing camera motion.
